decisions.reason: A multi-model line close to the core offer, featured on the home page in both years, carries heavy visible commitment, so management will persist with it.
The one-tier pyramid is central to the firm's traditional identity and was prominently shown, so any weak sales would be attributed to seasonal or pandemic effects rather than to the product itself.
Despite being distant from the core, the electronic music box line represents substantial investment and a publicly announced new direction, which management will want to justify.
The motif platform gained its own page in 2019 and complements the music box line, so the growing commitment favors keeping it, though its distance from the core adds some risk.
This accessory is only mentioned rather than featured, so commitment is lower, but it is tied to the music box system the firm has invested in and costs little to keep.
The Dresden-themed pyramid builds directly on the firm's established craft offer and was shown on the home page, making it a natural keeper.
